comment: M08 golden-slice art review. Eye-height spectator views of every beat on the authored route through the custody archive, before any guard wakes. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m08_custodian_of_record.json. Look at each still against docs/design/moon.md, the art bible and the Recall Notice bar; this is art review, not combat or fresh-player evidence. Guards, the Auditor's channel, the Proximity Mine and the machine's fall appear through client/qa/m08-golden-guards.json and the combat route in client/qa/m08_custodian_of_record.json.

states.name: checkpoint_arrival
states.note: Arrival at the entry checkpoint: the intake desk, its form, the hall opening beyond.

states.name: checkpoint_desk
states.note: The intake desk at fighting distance: forms, the queue, the issued kit.

states.name: observation_cage
states.note: The desk-top route and the observation cage over the checkpoint, marked with a six.

states.name: hall_entrance
states.note: Through the checkpoint opening: the records hall around the shaft, the galleries stacked above.

states.name: hall_desks_west
states.note: Human-facing desks: where a person becomes a registered asset.

states.name: hall_records_wall
states.note: The records wall: cabinets, drawers, the institution's machinery.

states.name: hall_shaft_up
states.note: At the hall rail: the shaft rising through both galleries to the hanging custody machine.

states.name: lost_property
states.note: The lost-property cage: confiscated jackets, one with the six.

states.name: west_stair
states.note: The west stair tower to the lower gallery.

states.name: lower_gallery
states.note: The lower gallery: open bays, the shaft rail, the registry desk ahead.

states.name: registry_desk
states.note: The registry desk where Renn waits with a lowered case.

states.name: lower_bays
states.note: The lower custody bays: personal remnants behind the forms.

states.name: mine_alcove
states.note: The one-entrance alcove and its equipment cage of mines.

states.name: mine_corridor
states.note: The corridor the post Sweepers walk up: where the mine goes.

states.name: east_stair
states.note: The east tower to the upper gallery.

states.name: upper_gallery
states.note: The upper gallery: custody platforms, broad cover, the Auditor's ground.

states.name: upper_seal
states.note: The custody seal and the upper bay shutters.

states.name: service_ring
states.note: The cooling ring: pipes, a quiet loop, the junction marked with a six.

states.name: cold_cabinet
states.note: Orrin's damaged backup in its cold cabinet.

states.name: machine_bridge
states.note: The machinery bridge: the custody machine on four glowing support nodes.

states.name: machine_well
states.note: Down the shaft from the bridge: every gallery to the hall floor.

states.name: evidence_desk
states.note: The transfer evidence on the bridge desk.

states.name: freight_landing
states.note: From the freight landing: the lane's lights below, the car, the panel.

states.name: freight_lane
states.note: The freight lane and the uncalled car under the maintenance panel.

states.name: noise_panel
states.note: Authorized noise. No action required. Readable with sound muted.
